prompt:
A clean line-art blocking diagram of one scene of a live-action short drama, vertical composition: the place of Image 1 drawn in simple black outlines on white, with the segment's people in their places at its start, the way a master shot shows the whole scene before it is cut into shots. Keep Image 1's camera position, framing, walls, windows, doorways and furniture, traced in outline; only add the people.
Image 1: the location Garden of the wedding venue, the front view, with no people
Image 2: the character sheet of Cassie (23), look S1
Image 3: the character sheet of Lauren (50), look S1
Image 4: the character sheet of George (55), look S1
Image 5: the character sheet of Guest 1 (25)
Image 6: the character sheet of Guest 2 (25)
Image 7: the character sheet of Natalie (25), look S1
Image 8: the character sheet of Sebastian (30), look S2
Image 9: the character sheet of Officiant (58)
Draw each person as a clean outline figure that can be told apart by hairstyle, build and the shape of their outfit, from their character sheet; no faces in detail. Do not copy a sheet's layout, white background or multiple views. Each person appears once, whole and at natural scale for the place, on the furniture and floor of Image 1, facing the way the start says.
Only eight people appear: Cassie, Lauren, George, Guest 1, Guest 2, Natalie, Sebastian, and Officiant. Nobody else is there.
At the start: Natalie stands at the rose-bush end of the wedding arch beside the front-row chair on the rose-bush side, holding her phone; Sebastian stands beside her under the arch on her boxwood-hedge side, hands in pockets; the Officiant stands just behind them at the centre of the arch. Lauren stands at the head of the aisle against the front-row chair on the boxwood-hedge side, her phone lowered in one hand; Cassie stands beside her on her arch side, arms folded over the empty gift box; George stands on Lauren's aisle side, holding the bouquet. Guest 1, holding up her phone, her flute on the silver tray, and Guest 2, holding a champagne flute, stand at the one small round white high cocktail table on the boxwood-hedge side.

No shading, solid black areas, colour or photographic rendering: dark hair and clothes are outlines left white inside; no text, letters, numbers, arrows, labels or watermark.
